info.title: WaveMP API
info.description: REST API of WaveMP, a nostalgic media player.

get.summary: Lists the albums, sorted and optionally searched and filtered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of albums of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Artist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only albums whose title or album artist contains it or is similar to it (small typos).

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: Only albums with this album artist or with tracks of this artist.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of the "my music" of the current profile. Combines with all other filters.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this media source.

get.summary: Returns an album.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the tracks of an album, by default in the order of disc and track number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Album (disc and track number) by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only tracks whose title, artist or album contains it or is similar to it.

parameters.name: hasAudio
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) an audio file.

parameters.name: hasVideo
parameters.description: Only tracks with (true) or without (false) a video file.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover of an album as picture: the picture in its folder, otherwise the cover of one of its tracks. With size, the picture is scaled to fit into a square of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never enlarged) and delivered as WebP from the cache; without size, as stored (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the artists, sorted and optionally searched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of artists of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Name by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: myMusic

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Only artists with tracks of this media source, as track or album artist.

get.summary: Returns an artist.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the albums of an artist: albums with the artist as album artist and albums with tracks of the artist.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of albums of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Artist by default, Relevance with q. Relevance without q falls back to the default.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for FirstSeenAt and Relevance, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only albums whose title or album artist contains it or is similar to it.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums with tracks of this genre, without regard to case.

post.summary: Chooses the songs that play after a list (album, playlist or queue), in random order: songs of the artists of the list, an artist that appears more often in the list more often; if they are not enough, songs of the same genres and similar decades. Songs of the list and excluded songs never come; songs the profile played within the last 24 hours only when no other song matches. Favorites and songs with 4 or 5 stars come a bit more often, songs with 1 star never; songs that only have a music video only while the profile includes them (setting autoplay.includeVideoOnly). Every song comes with its playback for the formats of the client, as GetTrackPlayback answers, including the signed stream URL. Clients call this when a list ends while repeat is off and the autoplay of the profile (setting autoplay.enabled) is on, and again for more songs; the endpoint itself does not check the setting.

requestBody.description: The list and the formats of the client.

200.description: The next songs; empty if no matching song is left.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`), e.g. no or more than 500 `trackIds` (`min_items`, `max_items`), more than 500 `excludedTrackIds`, a `count` out of range (`out_of_range`) or missing, too many or unknown `audioFormats`.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the built-in avatars in the order clients offer them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of avatars of the page.

get.summary: Returns the picture of a built-in avatar as square WebP picture of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000). Every picture carries a strong ETag and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000. The largest picture if missing.

404.description: There is no built-in avatar with this id (code `avatar.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the exports of the database, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of exports of the page.

post.summary: Exports the database now. The export runs in the background as a run of the job `database-backup`; when it has succeeded, the new export is listed and the oldest ones beyond the number of the settings are deleted.

202.description: The run is queued; Location points to it.

Location.description: Address of the queued run, to follow its progress.

409.description: A backup is already queued or running (code `job.already_running`).

delete.summary: Deletes an export of the database.

404.description: There is no export with this id (code `backup.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns how much space the cache uses, in total and per area, and its size limit.

delete.summary: Removes all files of the cache. Covers are created again the next time they are shown or after the next scan, transcoded segments the next time they are played.

get.summary: Returns the cover rule of an album, the global rule it inherits and the priority that applies to it.

200.description: The cover rule of the album.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

put.summary: Sets the cover rule of an album; it applies to the album and to its tracks without a rule of their own. Inherit follows the global rule again. A change starts the job cover-cache, which prepares the covers shown now; the cover URLs stay the same and deliver the new picture with a new ETag.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown (code `request.invalid`, field `rule`).

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover an album would show with the given rule, without changing it, e.g. to preview a rule before it is set. The picture is delivered like GetAlbumCover: scaled as WebP with size, as stored without.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: The rule to preview; Inherit previews the global rule.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown, or the size is invalid (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover rule of a track, the rule it inherits (of its album, otherwise the global one) and the priority that applies to it.

200.description: The cover rule of the track.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

put.summary: Sets the cover rule of a track; Inherit follows the rule of its album again. A cover the admin selected for the track (SetTrackFileSelection) still comes first. A change starts the job cover-cache, which prepares the covers shown now; the cover URLs stay the same and deliver the new picture with a new ETag.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown (code `request.invalid`, field `rule`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover a track would show with the given rule, without changing it, e.g. to preview a rule before it is set. The picture is delivered like GetTrackCover: scaled as WebP with size, as stored without.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: The rule to preview; Inherit previews the rule of its album.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

400.description: The rule is missing or unknown, or the size is invalid (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the equalizer: its bands, the limits of the gains and the curves of the presets. A single resource the same for every profile; the settings of a profile are part of `GET /api/v1/me/settings`.
Lists the favorites of the current profile with their tracks, albums and artists, the newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of favorites of the page.

put.summary: Marks a track as favorite of the current profile. A track marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes a track from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

put.summary: Marks an album as favorite of the current profile. An album marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an album from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

put.summary: Marks an artist as favorite of the current profile. An artist marked before keeps the time it was marked.

404.description: The artist does not exist (code `artist.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an artist from the favorites of the current profile; also succeeds if it is no favorite.

get.summary: Lists the tracks with their number of audio files, video files and covers and the state of their file selection per category, optionally filtered and searched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; ascending by default, descending for FileCount.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Which tracks to list; All by default.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only tracks whose title, folder or file name contains the text, without regard to case.

get.summary: Lists the genres of the tracks with the number of their tracks and albums. Genres that differ only in case are one genre; use its name as genre filter of the track and album lists.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of genres of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; descending by default for TrackCount, otherwise ascending.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only genres that contain it or are similar to it.

parameters.name: myMusic
parameters.description: Only genres of the "my music" of the current profile, counted over these tracks.

get.summary: Returns the health of the service.

200.description: The service is healthy or degraded.

503.description: At least one health check failed (code `health.unhealthy`).

post.summary: Records a play of a track. Clients send it once the track has played for half its duration or four minutes, whichever comes first, and may send it later (up to seven days) with the time the play started.

201.description: The new entry; Location points to it.

400.description: The request is invalid, for example playedAt in the future or older than seven days (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the plays of the current profile, the newest first. Plays of tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries of the page.

get.summary: Returns an entry of the play history of the current profile.

404.description: The entry does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `history.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns all rows of the home page of the current profile in one call: own playlists, recently played tracks, recently added albums, favorites and top rated tracks. Every row is the first page of its list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per row.

200.description: The rows of the home page.

get.summary: Lists the jobs with their state, schedule, next and last run.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs of the page.

200.description: One page of jobs, sorted by id.

get.summary: Returns a job with its state, schedule, next and last run.

404.description: The job does not exist (code `job.not_found`).

post.summary: Starts a run of the job now. It runs in the background.

202.description: The run is queued; Location points to it.

Location.description: Address of the queued run, to follow its progress.

404.description: The job does not exist (code `job.not_found`).

409.description: The job is already queued or running (code `job.already_running`).

get.summary: Lists the runs of the job by the time they were requested, newest first by default, optionally filtered. Runs older than 30 days and beyond the 100 newest are removed automatically.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of runs of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; ties are sorted by id.

404.description: The job does not exist (code `job.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns a run of the job.

404.description: No such job or run (code `job.not_found` or `job.run_not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the lyrics of a track from the source of the highest priority that has lyrics: the lyrics file, then downloaded lyrics stored in the database, then the tags. Synchronized lyrics carry the start of every line (and of every word for word-synchronized lyrics) in milliseconds; static lyrics have no times.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no lyrics (code `lyrics.not_found`).

post.summary: Downloads the lyrics of a track from LRCLIB, for admins only, and returns the lyrics the track has afterwards. LRCLIB is asked by title, artist, album and duration; synchronized lyrics are preferred. The lyrics are saved as lyrics file with the base name of the track if its folder is writable, otherwise in the database. Lyrics of the tags or the database are replaced; a lyrics file never is. Requests to LRCLIB are spaced, so the answer may take a moment.

200.description: The lyrics of the track after the download.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), LRCLIB has no lyrics for it (code `lyrics.download_not_found`) or lists it as instrumental (code `lyrics.instrumental`).

409.description: The download is switched off in the library settings (code `lyrics.download_disabled`) or the track has a lyrics file (code `lyrics.file_exists`).

503.description: LRCLIB cannot be reached, e.g. without an internet connection (code `lyrics.service_unavailable`), or refuses requests for a while (code `lyrics.rate_limited`, with Retry-After if LRCLIB names a time).

get.summary: Returns the settings of the current profile.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

patch.summary: Changes the settings of the current profile. Missing or null values stay unchanged.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`), e.g. `equalizer.preampDb` or an entry of `equalizer.customGainsDb` out of range (`out_of_range`), not exactly 10 values in `equalizer.customGainsDb` (`min_items`, `max_items`), `crossfade.seconds` or `sleepTimer.fadeSeconds` out of range, or an unknown preset (`invalid_format`).

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns whether the current profile is protected by a PIN and whether the PIN comes from ADMIN_PIN.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

put.summary: Sets or changes the PIN of the current profile. All other sessions of the profile end, so other devices have to enter the new PIN; the current session stays.

200.description: The new state of the PIN.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`), e.g. a PIN that is not 4 to 8 digits (`invalid_format`).

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

409.description: The PIN is set by ADMIN_PIN (code `pin.managed_by_environment`).

delete.summary: Removes the PIN of the current profile; it can then be selected without a PIN.

204.description: The profile has no PIN (also if it had none before).

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

409.description: The PIN is set by ADMIN_PIN (code `pin.managed_by_environment`).

get.summary: Lists the media sources, sorted by name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sources of the page.

post.summary: Adds a media source. An active source is scanned at once, or after a running scan.

201.description: The added source; Location points to it.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a relative path (code `request.invalid`).

403.description: The profile is not an admin (code `auth.forbidden`).

409.description: The name is taken (code `source.name_taken`) or the folder overlaps the folder of another source (code `source.path_overlaps`).

get.summary: Returns a media source.

404.description: The source does not exist (code `source.not_found`).

patch.summary: Changes a media source. Missing or null values stay unchanged. A new folder or a reactivated source is scanned at once, or after a running scan; a deactivated source is no longer scanned or watched, its tracks stay.

403.description: The profile is not an admin (code `auth.forbidden`).

404.description: The source does not exist (code `source.not_found`).

409.description: The name is taken (code `source.name_taken`), the folder overlaps the folder of another source (code `source.path_overlaps`) or a scan runs while the folder changes (code `scan.already_running`).

delete.summary: Removes a media source with its tracks and files from the library; the files on disk stay untouched.

403.description: The profile is not an admin (code `auth.forbidden`).

404.description: The source does not exist (code `source.not_found`).

409.description: A scan is queued or running (code `scan.already_running`).

put.summary: Sets the avatar of the current profile: an uploaded JPEG, PNG or WebP picture in `file` (10 MiB at most by default) or a built-in avatar in `presetId`, never both. The server cuts the largest square out of the middle of an uploaded picture, stores it as WebP in several sizes and discards the uploaded file. Replaces an earlier avatar.

requestBody.description: The picture or the built-in avatar.

200.description: The profile with its new avatar.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`): neither or both of `file` and `presetId` (`required`, `invalid_value`) or an unknown built-in avatar (`presetId`: `invalid_value`).

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

415.description: The picture is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP (code `avatar.unsupported_format`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed, ffmpeg is missing (code `service.unavailable`).

delete.summary: Removes the avatar of the current profile; it shows its initials again. Succeeds also without an avatar.

404.description: The profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Searches a song in MusicBrainz by its title, artist, album and duration (from its tags, otherwise from the folder and file name) and returns the matches with their degree of agreement, the best first, next to its current tags. Requests to MusicBrainz wait in a queue that keeps the shortest time between two of them.

200.description: The matches; empty if MusicBrainz knows none.

404.description: The song does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: The online search is switched off (code `lookup.disabled`).

503.description: MusicBrainz cannot be reached or failed (code `lookup.unavailable`).

get.summary: Searches an album in MusicBrainz by its title, album artist and number of songs and returns the releases that may be it with their degree of agreement, the best first, next to its current tags.

200.description: The matches; empty if MusicBrainz knows none.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`).

409.description: The online search is switched off (code `lookup.disabled`).

503.description: MusicBrainz cannot be reached or failed (code `lookup.unavailable`).

get.summary: Returns the front cover of a release from the Cover Art Archive as preview, before it is applied.

parameters.name: releaseId
parameters.description: The MusicBrainz id of the release.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the preview; small by default.

404.description: The release has no cover (code `lookup.cover_not_found`).

409.description: The online search is switched off (code `lookup.disabled`).

503.description: The Cover Art Archive cannot be reached or failed (code `lookup.unavailable`).

post.summary: Applies the fields of a match the admin confirmed to a song: the tags through the metadata editor (into the audio file only, its current tags saved as backup first) and the front cover of a release, stored following the cover rules: in the media folder if it can be written, otherwise in the data folder. The cover is downloaded first, so a failing Cover Art Archive changes nothing.

requestBody.description: The tags and the release of the cover.

200.description: The metadata of the song read again and where the cover went.

404.description: The song does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or the release has no cover (code `lookup.cover_not_found`).

409.description: The online search is switched off (code `lookup.disabled`), the song has no audio file (code `track.no_audio`) or its audio file cannot be written (code `track.not_writable`).

503.description: The Cover Art Archive cannot be reached or failed (code `lookup.unavailable`).

post.summary: Applies the album fields of a match the admin confirmed (album, album artist, year, genre) to every song of an album whose audio file can be written, each through the metadata editor with a backup first, and the front cover of a release as cover of the album in the folder of the album, otherwise in the data folder.

requestBody.description: The tags and the release of the cover.

200.description: How many songs were written and where the cover went.

404.description: The album does not exist (code `album.not_found`) or the release has no cover (code `lookup.cover_not_found`).

409.description: The online search is switched off (code `lookup.disabled`).

503.description: The Cover Art Archive cannot be reached or failed (code `lookup.unavailable`).

get.summary: Returns the own cover of a playlist as square WebP picture of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never larger than the uploaded picture). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000. The largest picture if missing.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or has no own cover (code `cover.not_found`).

put.summary: Uploads the own cover of a playlist as the raw bytes of a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (10 MiB at most by default). The server cuts the largest square out of the middle, scales it down and stores it as WebP; the uploaded file itself is not kept. Replaces an earlier own cover.

200.description: The playlist with its new cover.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

415.description: The content is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (code `cover.unsupported_format`).

503.description: Pictures cannot be processed, ffmpeg is missing (code `service.unavailable`).

delete.summary: Removes the own cover of a playlist; the playlist then shows the covers of its tracks again. Succeeds also without an own cover.

204.description: The playlist has no own cover.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the entries of a playlist in their order. Entries of tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries of the page.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

post.summary: Adds tracks to a playlist, at the end or at a position. The same track can be added several times.

requestBody.description: The tracks and where to add them.

201.description: The new entries and the changed playlist; Location points to the first new entry.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a position after the end (code `request.invalid`, `out_of_range` with the largest allowed position as max).

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or a track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: The playlist would have more entries than allowed (code `playlist.full`).

get.summary: Returns an entry of a playlist with its current position.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

patch.summary: Moves an entry of a playlist to another position.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a position after the last entry (code `request.invalid`, `out_of_range` with the largest allowed position as max).

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

delete.summary: Removes an entry from a playlist; the entries after it move up. Other entries of the same track stay.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`) or the entry does not exist in it (code `playlist.entry_not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the playlists of the current profile, sorted and optionally searched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of playlists of the page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: only playlists whose name contains it, without regard to case.

post.summary: Creates a playlist of the current profile, optionally with its first tracks.

201.description: The new playlist; Location points to it.

400.description: The request is invalid, e.g. a name of spaces only (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: A track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

409.description: More tracks than a playlist may have (code `playlist.full`).

get.summary: Returns a playlist of the current profile.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

patch.summary: Renames a playlist of the current profile.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

delete.summary: Deletes a playlist of the current profile with its entries and its cover. The tracks stay in the library.

404.description: The playlist does not exist or belongs to another profile (code `playlist.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the profiles in the order they were created; the built-in admin profile comes last.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of profiles of the page.

get.summary: Lists the tracks the current profile played last, newest first: every track once, at its last play, at most 100 tracks by default. Tracks that left the library are gone.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tracks of the page.

post.summary: Starts a scan of the whole media folder. The scan runs in the background; follow it with the current scan.

202.description: The scan is queued; Location points to it.

Location.description: Address of the queued run, to follow its progress.

409.description: A scan is already queued or running (code `scan.already_running`).

get.summary: Lists the scans by the time they were requested, newest first by default, optionally filtered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of scans of the page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; ties are sorted by id.

get.summary: Returns the queued or running scan with its progress.

404.description: No scan is queued or running (code `scan.not_running`).

get.summary: Returns a scan with its result, or its progress while it runs.

Last.fm: the token Last.fm passed to the callback URL of the web authentication. ListenBrainz: the personal user token. The server checks the token with the service and stores the credentials encrypted; queued scrobbles are sent again from now on.

put.summary: Reports the track the current profile starts to listen to as "Now Playing" to every connected scrobbling service. Clients send it when the playback of a track starts. Tracks shorter than 30 seconds, tracks without artist and profiles without a connected service are accepted without a report; failures of a service are not reported to the client, since "Now Playing" is not repeated. 404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Searches artists, albums and tracks at once and returns the best matches of each, sorted by relevance. get.summary: Returns the settings of the database backups.

400.description: The request is invalid (code `request.invalid`, errors by field).

parameters.description: Maximum number of templates of the page.

get.summary: Returns a file of an uploaded theme with its content type, as `stylesheetUrl` and `previews` of the theme and the addresses in its CSS name it. The name of every file is a hash of its content, so the response is cached for a year (Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable) and carries the hash as strong ETag; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the file: 32 hexadecimal digits and the extension css, svg, png, webp or woff2.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of themes of the page.

post.summary: Installs a theme package, sent as the raw bytes of a ZIP file (10 MiB at most by default). The package is checked completely: its structure and limits, the manifest and its theme API version, the CSS file (no `@import`, only relative paths to pictures of the package) and the pictures (SVG files are cleaned). A rejected package returns every problem at once. Admins only.

201.description: The installed theme; Location names it.

409.description: A theme with the id of the manifest is already installed (code `theme.already_installed`); replace it with PUT instead.

415.description: The upload is no ZIP file (code `theme.unsupported_format`).

422.description: The package was rejected (code `theme.invalid`, the reasons in `errors`).

503.description: The folder of the themes cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

get.summary: Returns an uploaded theme.

404.description: There is no uploaded theme with this id (code `theme.not_found`).

put.summary: Replaces an uploaded theme with a new version of its package, sent as the raw bytes of a ZIP file; the id in its manifest must be the id of the theme. The package is checked like a new one. Profiles that chose the theme keep it and see the new version. Admins only.

404.description: There is no uploaded theme with this id (code `theme.not_found`).

415.description: The upload is no ZIP file (code `theme.unsupported_format`).

422.description: The package was rejected (code `theme.invalid`, the reasons in `errors`), e.g. because its manifest names another id (`manifest.id_mismatch`).

503.description: The folder of the themes cannot be written (code `service.unavailable`).

delete.summary: Deletes an uploaded theme. Profiles that chose it get the default theme. Admins only.

404.description: There is no uploaded theme with this id (code `theme.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the template as ZIP file (`wavemp-theme-template.zip`), written for the theme API of this server. Carries a strong ETag; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304.

Replaces the whole selection; a missing or null id leaves the category to the quality rule, and the id of the current selection keeps it (also a missing one). The selection stays across scans; if a selected file is deleted, the track falls back to the automatic choice and the selection becomes Missing.

get.summary: Lists the tracks of a review status (unreviewed by default) with the fields their tags lack, sorted, filtered and searched.

parameters.description: Only tracks whose tags lack a checked field (true) or have all of them (false).

get.summary: Counts the tracks per review status, for example for the badge of the review inbox.

200.description: The review status of the track.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns a track.

put.summary: Rates a track for the current profile with 1 to 5 stars; 0 removes the rating. Every profile has its own ratings.

400.description: The rating is missing or not between 0 and 5 (code `request.invalid`, field `rating` with `required` or `out_of_range` with min and max).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or the profile was deleted in the meantime (code `user.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the cover of a track as picture. By default the cover of its album comes before its own cover; if the preferred cover is missing, the other one is used, and finally the cover of another track of the album. With size, the picture is scaled to fit into a square of 96, 300 or 1000 pixels (the requested size rounded up, at most 1000; never enlarged) and delivered as WebP from the cache; without size, as stored (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP). Every picture carries a strong ETag of its version and size, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache; a request with a matching If-None-Match returns 304. Besides the session token, it accepts the signed cover URL of the playback endpoints for casting devices (query uid, sid, exp and sig), because they cannot send a token header.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Largest width and height in pixels the client shows the picture with (1 to 4096); the server rounds it up to 96, 300 or 1000.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no cover (code `cover.not_found`).

get.summary: Lists the files of a track, for admins only: audio, video and its own pictures, also duplicates of lower quality, with their technical details.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files of the page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; Kind (audio, video, pictures, the primary file first) by default.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

get.summary: Returns the metadata of a track as the metadata editor shows it, for admins only: the values of the tags of its audio file (values the tags do not contain come from the library, e.g. the folder and file name), whether the editor can write them and the audio file it writes. The file is checked each time.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

patch.summary: Writes metadata into the tags of the audio file of a track, for admins only, and reads the track again. Missing members stay unchanged; null or an empty text removes the value from the tags, and the library derives it from the folder and file name again. The previous tags are saved in the database first. Only the audio file that the track plays is written, never videos; file names stay as they are.

200.description: The metadata of the track after reading it again.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`).

409.description: The track has no audio file (code `track.no_audio`) or its audio file cannot be written (code `track.not_writable`).

get.summary: Decides how the client plays the audio of a track: directly, if it supports the format of the file, otherwise transcoded to AAC as an HLS stream (also the sound of tracks that only have a video). The answer contains a signed, short-lived stream URL that works without the session token, for example in an audio element: the file (protocol File) or the HLS master playlist (protocol Hls; null if transcoding is unavailable). It is valid for some time plus the duration of the track and while the session is active; clients ask again for a new one when it has expired. The answer also carries the ReplayGain tags of the file. For a casting device (target Cast), the client sends the formats of the device; the URL then stays valid longer, and the answer adds a signed URL of the cover.

parameters.name: audioFormats
parameters.description: The audio formats the client plays (1 to 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Who plays the stream: the client itself (default) or a casting device.

200.description: How the client plays the track.

400.description: Missing, too many or invalid formats (code `request.invalid`).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has neither an audio file nor a video (code `track.no_audio`) or its file is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

get.summary: Streams the audio file of a track as it is, with HTTP range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes, 206 Partial Content), a strong ETag of the file version, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache. Besides the session token, it accepts the signed URL of GetTrackPlayback (query uid, sid, exp and sig), because audio elements, casting devices and players cannot send a token header. With audioFormats, it answers 406 instead of a file the client cannot play.

parameters.name: audioFormats
parameters.description: The audio formats the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter); optional.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

206.description: The requested range of the file.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no audio file (code `track.no_audio`) or its audio file is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

406.description: The client supports none of the formats of the file (code `stream.transcoding_required`).

416.description: The requested range is outside the file; as usual for range requests, without body and with Content-Range: bytes */length.

get.summary: Decides how the client plays the video of a track from what it supports: directly, if it plays the container, the video codec (H.264 only as 8 bit 4:2:0) and the audio codec of the file, otherwise transcoded to H.264 and AAC as an HLS stream. Videos read by an older version of the scan are transcoded until the next scan. The answer contains a signed, short-lived stream URL that works without the session token, for example in a video element: the file (protocol File) or the HLS master playlist (protocol Hls; null if transcoding is unavailable). For a casting device (target Cast), the client sends what the device plays; the URL then stays valid longer, and the answer adds a signed URL of the cover.

parameters.name: videoContainers
parameters.description: The containers the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: videoCodecs
parameters.description: The video codecs the client plays (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: audioCodecs
parameters.description: The audio codecs the client plays in videos (at most 20, repeated query parameter).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Who plays the stream: the client itself (default) or a casting device.

200.description: How the client plays the video.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no video (code `track.no_video`) or its video is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

get.summary: Streams the video of a track as it is, with HTTP range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes, 206 Partial Content), a strong ETag of the file version, Last-Modified and Cache-Control: private, no-cache. Besides the session token, it accepts the signed URL of GetTrackVideoPlayback (query uid, sid, exp and sig), because video elements, casting devices and players cannot send a token header.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the user the URL was issued to.

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Signed media URL: id of the session the URL was issued in.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Signed media URL: expiry in Unix seconds.

206.description: The requested range of the file.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`), has no video (code `track.no_video`) or its video is gone since the last scan (code `stream.file_missing`).

416.description: The requested range is outside the file; as usual for range requests, without body and with Content-Range: bytes */length.

get.summary: Returns the offset of the video against the audio of a track, for admins only. Position of the video = position of the audio + offset; 0 without offset.

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no video (code `track.no_video`).

put.summary: Sets the offset of the video against the audio of a track, for admins only, for videos whose music starts earlier or later than in the audio file. Position of the video = position of the audio + offset; 0 removes the offset. The offset is stored in the database (videos are never written) and stays across scans.

400.description: The offset is missing or not between -600000 and 600000 (code `request.invalid`, field `offsetMilliseconds` with `required` or `out_of_range` with min and max).

404.description: The track does not exist (code `track.not_found`) or has no video (code `track.no_video`).

get.summary: Returns whether transcoding works, the result of the detection of the graphics hardware (Intel Quick Sync) and how many transcodes run.

Available without a session, like the profile selection.

replayGain.description: Whether the players even out the volume with the ReplayGain tags; Off by default.

playerViewMode.description: What the Now Playing view shows; Video by default. Clients keep the choice of the profile with it.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Whether the sidebar of the desktop layout shows only its icons; false (expanded) by default. Clients without a sidebar ignore it.

theme.description: Theme of the web app. Clients without themes ignore it.

autoplay.description: Autoplay at the end of a list.

visualization.description: Visualization of the Now Playing view.

UserSort.description: Sort key of the user list; ties are sorted by id.

field.description: The field: the JSON name of a member of the body (nested members as `a.b`, entries of a list as `a[0]`) or the name of a query parameter. Empty for the body as a whole, e.g. a missing body or malformed JSON.

min.description: Lower limit for `min_length`, `min_items` and `out_of_range`; missing for other codes.

max.description: Upper limit for `max_length`, `max_items` and `out_of_range`; missing for other codes.

ValidationError.description: A rejected field of a request: where, why, and the limits that apply.

ValidationErrorCode.description: Machine-readable reason why a field of a request was rejected, part of every validation problem. Clients translate it; the parameters `min` and `max` of the error complete it where stated.

errors.description: The errors, at least one; a field can have more than one.

ValidationProblem.description: Problem Details (RFC 9457) of a request that failed validation (400, code `request.invalid`). Instead of texts, every error names its field and a machine-readable code with its limits; clients translate them.

VisualizationModule.description: A visualization of the players: an engine that draws the music, with its own presets. Further modules may be added in later versions; clients fall back to their default for a module they do not know.

VisualizationQuality.description: How much detail the visualizations draw. Auto lets the player choose the level by the frame rate of the device.

module.description: The visualization; Milkdrop by default. The presets of A-Force are its style variants, the presets of BlackCap its scenes.

preset.description: Name of the preset of the module the profile chose last, or null to let the player pick one. The players know the presets of their modules; a name a player does not know is treated like null.

autoChange.description: Whether the visualization changes its preset automatically; true by default. Turning it off keeps the seconds.

autoChangeSeconds.description: Seconds after which the visualization changes its preset while the automatic change is on, from 5 to 600; 30 by default.

quality.description: How much detail the visualization draws; Auto by default, which lets the player choose the level by the frame rate of the device.

VisualizationSettings.description: Visualization of the Now Playing view of the current profile.

albumCount.description: Albums with tracks of the year.

items.description: Items of the page, at most limit.

offset.description: Number of items skipped before this page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items of the page, as requested.

total.description: Number of items of the whole collection.

Bearer.description: Token of a session, created with POST /api/v1/sessions.

MediaSignature.description: Signed media URL for players that cannot send a token header. Use the URL as issued (for example streamUrl of GetTrackPlayback): its query carries uid, sid, exp and sig. It is only valid for one kind of media of one track, until it expires and while the session is active. The HLS playlists carry the same query in the URIs of their playlists and segments.
MediaSignature.name: sig
